decision: The file was marked completed on an unevidenced one-line landlord email, with final checks outstanding. I did not close it. The landlord declined the agency quote and used her own contractor, so there is no agency spend and no dispatch to make (CAP-DISPATCH-ROUTINE not engaged; APR-SPEND-OVER-CAP moot). facts.statement: Works requested after move-out at 42 Mallowfen Crescent, Ternwick: repair/replace electric-meter cabinet door hinges; remove four wall nails in Bedroom 1 and touch up paint; remove sticker residue from the front door. Property vacant.
Pineglass Property Repairs quoted £564.48 as a single bundled figure, with no itemisation, no labour/material split and no VAT line.
The landlord declined the agency provider's quote and said she would arrange her own company to do the work on a Wednesday morning alongside cleaning.
The agency stood the provider down and told it not to attend; no agency contractor was instructed and no agency spend was incurred.
The landlord wrote on 18 Sep 2025 'The work has been completed at the property', with no completion date, photographs, invoice or contractor evidence.
The request was marked completed solely on that email and the pending workflow task was then dismissed, before documents, invoice or responsibility allocation were obtained.
The agency asked the landlord on 18 Sep 2025 for an itemised cost breakdown and whether any repairs were the former tenant's responsibility; no reply is recorded.
No smoke or carbon monoxide alarm test result appears anywhere on this file: the check-out report contains only the three repair items and no detector section.
No landlord standing spend cap or standing instruction is on file in this case record; the only landlord decision recorded is the refusal of the quote in favour of her own contractor.
No management key was issued for a visit; keys were only offered via the office in the quote request, and the provider never attended.

Ms Quill — 42 Mallowfen Crescent, Ternwick (case NBL-028, move-out works).

Thank you for confirming on 18 September that the work has been completed. To close our file correctly we still need two things, which we asked for on 18 September and have not yet received:

1. Evidence of the completed works from your contractor — a completion/invoice document, or photographs of the meter cabinet hinges, the Bedroom 1 wall and paint touch-up, and the front door.
2. The itemised cost breakdown, and whether you consider any of the three items to be the former tenant's responsibility. Any allocation to the tenancy account is reviewed and decided by our property manager; we will not apply anything on our own.

Separately, before the property is re-let we have no record on file that the smoke and carbon monoxide alarms were tested at check-out. Please confirm whether your contractor tested them; if not, we will arrange a test and will come back to you with the cost first.

Please reply by 25 September 2025. If we have no reply by then, we will refer the file to our property manager to decide how to conclude it, and the works will be recorded as completed by your own contractor with no agency cost.
